messages:
alex_marketing: Hey @runtime — finalizing launch narrative and need a tight set of artifacts. Can you run a focused validation pass on the numbers we'll put in the press deck + webinar? Need raw artifacts + a 1-paragraph method note.
priya_marketing: The ask: 3 traffic profiles (interactive demo single-turn, webinar load 50 concurrent, and batched embed API). For each: p50/p95 latency, throughput, cost-per-1k tokens est, and warmup profile. Also quantized vs fp16 comparison for the 8k model.
sam_runtime: Ack. Is there a canonical input bundle we should use or do you want us to resample from the demo payloads? Also: target region + hardware?
alex_marketing: Use the demo payloads we shared last week (s3 link in the marketing folder). Region us-west-2. Hardware: the Dedicated pool spec we discussed (A100-ish). If capacity is limited, a matched vCPU/GPU variant is fine but note it.
evan_runtime: Quick clarifying Qs: 1) What concurrency/arrival pattern for "webinar load 50 concurrent" — steady 50 or ramp? 2) For embed batch targets, what's the max batch size we should optimize for?
priya_marketing: Ramp from 0 to 50 over 2 mins then hold 50 for 10 mins. Embed batch: realistic max spike 64, typical 8.
sam_runtime: Cool. We'll do: cold start (empty kv/warm cache), warmed run (standard warmup N=100 requests), and quantized warmup sweep. We'll produce: raw trace logs, perf summary csv, and the method blurb you can paste. ETA ~ 18 hours.
maya_ops: Heads-up — if you hit the Dedicated pool at that scale we may need to temporarily expand burst capacity. @sam_runtime ping me when you schedule so I can provision.
sam_runtime: Scheduling now. Tagging deploy-bot to kick off a controlled run:
```
/deploy bench-run --bundle s3://redwood/marketing/demo-bundle-v2.json --region us-west-2 --pool dedicated-launch-50 --concurrency 50 --ramp 120 --hold 600 --embed-batch-max 64 --quant-modes fp16,int8
```
deploy-bot: Job queued: bench-run-1754441234-01. Estimated runtime 35m. Notifications on completion.
priya_marketing: Thanks — can you also include a tiny reproducibility pack: the exact curl/SDK requests used for the single-turn demo + random seed(s) for any probabilistic sampling? We want to show reviewers how to run locally.
evan_runtime: Will include: curl snippets (single request + batch), RNG seeds, exact model revision hash, and the kernel/quant flags. We'll also note any post-processing (tokenization settings, stop sequences).
sam_runtime: After the run we'll attach: perf_summary.csv, raw_traces.tar.gz, example-responses.jsonl (100 samples), and a 3-sentence method note. If anything looks flaky we'll rerun with larger warmup.
alex_marketing: Perfect. One last ask: call out any differences in behavior between quantized and fp16 — e.g., incoherent tokenization or odd completions — we may want to avoid stating quantized parity if we see regressions.
maya_ops: Run started (1754441250). I'll monitor. If memory pressure spikes I'll alert and capture logs.
sam_runtime: Run complete (success). Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood/marketing/bench-results/1754441234/. Dropping the top-level summary here: p50/p95 and cost estimates in the CSV. Attaching method blurb now.
priya_marketing: Received, quick skim: numbers look sane. We might ask for a targeted rerun for the embed profile with batch=32 only to tighten variance.
evan_runtime: Noted. If you want low-variance results we'll do 3 deterministic runs and report mean+stdev. Want us to schedule that?
alex_marketing: Yes please — schedule 3 runs for embed batch=32, ramp as before. Aim to complete before tomorrow EOD. Thanks everyone :rocket:
